name: Fair's Fair!
source:
A retelling of Twofold's Caprice path through the eyes of Millie. 

With the writing club down yet another prospective member and her personal life threatening to collapse around her, Millie finds surprising support from her otherwise neutral friend and roommate Hayley.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan/posts/announcing-fairs-173573404]Patreon post[/url]]
translation:
以米莉的视角重新讲述《Twofold》中“随想”（Caprice）路线的故事。

眼看写作社又流失了一名准社员，自己的私人生活也濒临崩溃边缘，米莉却从平日里向来保持中立的好友兼室友海莉那里，获得了意想不到的支持。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan/posts/announcing-fairs-173573404]Patreon动态[/url]]
